typedJson.name: nlohmann/json
typedJson.scope: Internal typed JSON parsing and escaping; Python-compatible canonical formatting in NativeCanonicalJson.hpp

build.parallelismPolicy: default -j4 on the authorized 6 logical CPU/12 GB host; use -j2 only after sustained swap or desktop stall
build.hostPythonAllowed: build generation and offline oracle only

onnx.remaining: Production canonical identity and full recipe/validation algorithm design remains OPEN

protobuf.abiRule: Use matching protoc, headers and shared runtime; all consumers in one process must resolve the same protobuf ABI. Host hashes describe the probe, not binaries for other OS images.

tokenizer.registryDependencies: All exact versions and checksums are normative in Cargo.lock; production package rename may change only local package identity.
tokenizer.threading: Read-only owner; serialize complete calls in C++ mutex; shared ownership outlives all calls.

rust.scope: Build-only isolated toolchain; no global environment mutation required.
rust.panic: unwind; catch at ABI; resource exhaustion abort is not a recoverable result

onnxruntime.evidenceScope: Existing /opt/onnxruntime-1.26.0 installation metadata and bytes; not rebuilt or product-qualified in T001.
onnxruntime.releaseRule: T016/T017 must record the actually loaded library, headers, providers and portable acquisition input; do not infer archive provenance from installed metadata.

coreDependencies.abiQualification: UNQUALIFIED; rebuild NDNSD and all affected consumers before current identity qualification

qualificationBoundary: Dependency probes establish only the stated byte/ABI properties. T015/T016 and complete runtime isolation remain required.
